nodes.summary: The statement of Kourovka Problem 20.75 is false: there are a prime $p$, a natural number $k$, a finite $p$-group $G$ all of whose abelian normal subgroups can be generated by at most $k$ elements, and an abelian subgroup of $G$ that cannot be generated by at most $2k$ elements.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 20.75 has a negative answer

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every prime $p$, every natural number $k$ and every finite $p$-group $G$, if every abelian normal subgroup of $G$ can be generated by at most $k$ elements, then every abelian subgroup of $G$ can be generated by at most $2k$ elements.
nodes.title: Pyber's question on generators of abelian subgroups (Kourovka 20.75)

nodes.summary: The statement of Kourovka Problem 20.76 is false: there are a prime $p$, a natural number $k$, a finite $p$-group $G$ all of whose abelian normal subgroups have order at most $p^k$, and an abelian subgroup of $G$ of order greater than $p^{2k}$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 20.76 has a negative answer

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every prime $p$, every natural number $k$ and every finite $p$-group $G$, if every abelian normal subgroup of $G$ has order at most $p^k$, then every abelian subgroup of $G$ has order at most $p^{2k}$.
nodes.title: Pyber's question on orders of abelian subgroups (Kourovka 20.76)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
